== Summary ==
Slip “•Passage To The Alderaan System” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 955, 1624, 1678)). Version [[Passage To The Alderaan System (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
